business_problem: Base39 needed to replace slow, subjective credit analysis workflows that could take up to 10 days and required specialist intervention to adapt machine learning models to new data sources.
solution_summary: Base39 rebuilt its credit analysis workflow on MongoDB Atlas running on Amazon Web Services and used MongoDB Atlas Vector Search as the feature and retrieval layer for agentic AI. Data from CRM systems, transactional records, and public databases is aggregated into Atlas, where flexible schemas let the team mix structured financial attributes with unstructured context. LangGraph orchestrates agents that call predictive machine learning models plus Amazon Bedrock-hosted Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude 3.5 Haiku models to recommend how data should be cleaned, transformed, and evaluated for loan risk. Atlas Vector Search enriches those LLM interactions with domain-specific context, supports real-time feature retrieval, and enables Chain-of-Thought reasoning over each application. Because the stack remained familiar to developers, Base39 shipped quickly while eliminating manual spreadsheet-driven analysis.

solution_components.role: Serves as Base39's core operational platform and feature store for structured and unstructured credit data.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search
solution_components.role: Retrieves relevant vectors and domain context so agentic workflows and models can analyze loan applications accurately in real time.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Hosts the large language models Base39 uses inside its credit-analysis workflow.

solution_components.name: LangGraph
solution_components.role: Orchestrates the agentic AI workflow that coordinates model calls and multi-step reasoning.

solution_components.name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
solution_components.role: Supports high-quality reasoning and generation for loan-risk analysis tasks.

solution_components.name: Claude 3.5 Haiku
solution_components.role: Handles fast, lower-latency model tasks inside Base39's credit workflow.

data_flow: CRM records, transactional histories, and public-database signals are aggregated into MongoDB Atlas, embedded and indexed with MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, then passed through LangGraph-orchestrated Bedrock model calls so agents can score loans, run what-if analysis, and surface risk recommendations to analysts.
business_outcome: Base39 deployed its AI-driven credit analysis platform in two weeks, cut loan-analysis costs by 96%, lowered infrastructure spend by 84%, and moved toward analyzing up to 10 loan applications per minute.
